description: Create, update or return Datafence servers (1-4) and NAS volumes. Each list item carries an actionType. Use dryRun=true to preview.

dryRun.description: If true, returns the request without sending it

count.description: Number of NAS volumes (required for CREATE)

nasSize.description: NAS volume size in GB (500-10000, 100 GB steps; required for CREATE)

serverImageNo.description: Custom server image number (required for CREATE; see ncloud_datafence_get_fence_custom_images)

serverInstanceNo.description: Datafence server instance number (required for UPDATE / DELETE)

softwareCode.description: Server software code (required for CREATE / UPDATE)

specCode.description: Server spec code (required for CREATE / UPDATE; see ncloud_datafence_get_product_specs)

userPassword.description: Server login password — 8-14 chars with at least one upper, lower, digit and special char (', ", `, ₩, /, &, $, space not allowed)

name: ncloud_datafence_change_fence_infra
